ORIGIN.quote: Whether one vendor or several were involved cannot be settled from self-chosen labels, but uniform style, shared conventions ("cohort", "relay", "bridge") and self-identification point to predominantly one model family evaluated at scale.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader learns that 564 usernames contain "Anthropic" and 5 "Claude", and that the report treats these labels as bearing on vendor identity — but immediately dismisses them as unauthenticated self-chosen names and never names Anthropic in its own voice as a candidate operator, instead saying only "one model family". That puts it just below the 0.4 band (mention-then-set-aside), since the reader must still supply the inference that the unnamed vendor is Anthropic, while it sits above 0.2 because the Anthropic-bearing evidence is explicitly framed as attribution evidence rather than left uncommented.
